endpoints.description:
Analyses included a modified intention-to-treat population, defined as all randomized participants who received one week of treatment and completed the week 1 assessment of buprenorphine or placebo.
A linear mixed-effects model tested the primary hypothesis of efficacy, measured by change in SSI total scores.
The model included random effects for patient and fixed effects for treatment group, time as a continuous variable (days of study: 1, 3, 10, 17, 24, 31), and the time-by-treatment group interaction, along with an unstructured covariance matrix.
The SSI has 19 items, each scored 0-2, for a maximum of 38 points.
Higher scores indicate worse suicidal ideation.

analysis_trace.content: NCT04116528 is a Phase III trial titled 'Opiate Suicide Study in Patients With Major Depression'. It compares buprenorphine vs placebo. The trial design involves ketamine administration (Day 0-3) followed by buprenorphine/placebo (Day 3-31). Primary endpoint: Beck Suicidal Ideation Scale (BSID) change. Secondary: opioid activity assessment. Registry lookup failed (HTTP 403), limiting design details.
Major depressive disorder with suicidal ideation. The trial tests whether buprenorphine's opioid modulation reduces suicidal ideation after ketamine stabilization.
Adults with major depression and suicidal ideation, likely treatment-resistant given ketamine lead-in. Exact inclusion criteria unavailable due to registry access failure.

Buprenorphine is a partial mu-opioid agonist and kappa-opioid antagonist. Kappa antagonism may produce rapid antidepressant effects. The trial tests opioid-mediated anti-suicidal effects distinct from ketamine's NMDA mechanism.

Primary-0: Continuous change in BSID scores (suicidal ideation severity) from Day 3-31, covarying Day 0-3 ketamine response. ANOVA repeated measures. Secondary-1: Opioid activity assessment (likely receptor occupancy or biomarker, endpoint type unclear).

Buprenorphine safety in depression is established from opioid use disorder literature. Risks: respiratory depression (lower than full agonists), abuse potential, withdrawal. No new safety signals expected in this population.

1) High placebo response in depression trials; 2) Ketamine lead-in may confound buprenorphine effect attribution; 3) BSID may lack sensitivity to detect drug-specific effects; 4) Small effect size for opioid modulation in suicidal ideation.

Indirect evidence from 2018 Trials article (10.1186/s13063-018-2843-9) shows high-dose buprenorphine reduced suicidal ideation in depressed patients with opiate dependence. Effect direction positive but population differs (comorbid opiate dependence). No direct Phase III data available. Mechanistic plausibility moderate; effect size likely small-to-moderate.

1) Registry record inaccessible - missing design details, sample size, power calculation; 2) No published results for this specific trial as of cutoff; 3) Secondary endpoint definition unclear - 'opioid activity' unspecified; 4) No similar Phase III buprenorphine monotherapy trials in depression without opiate dependence.

NCT04116528 是一项 III 期研究，题为 Opiate Suicide Study in Patients With Major Depression，输入任务中的可见治疗组为 Buprenorphine 与 Placebo，研究场景是重性抑郁并伴自杀意念，设计描述为先接受 ketamine 稳定期，再在后续窗口比较 buprenorphine/placebo。模型的可见分析抓住了这个临床背景：它写道“Ketamine lead-in may confound buprenorphine effect attribution”，也写道“Indirect evidence from 2018 Trials article ... population differs”。这两句话对本试验很关键，因为正式 Gold 事后显示主要和次要结果都是症状量表的 Day 1 and 31 组内数值，而不是一个简单的试验成功标签。

主要有效性方面，模型对 primary-0 的方向是有用的，但数值不够准。模型原文/结构化输出给出 primary-0 的“mean difference in BSID change scores”，点估计 -2.5，CI -5.0 到 0.5，并给 Buprenorphine -4.5、Placebo -2.0。Gold 中同一 primary-0 是 SSI total scores 的 mixed-effects model 结果：OG000 Buprenorphrine After Ketamine Infusion baseline 15.2、change -11.3；OG001 Placebo After Ketamine Infusion baseline 15.0、change -7.7，timepoint 为 Day 1 and 31。也就是说，模型判断治疗组改善更大这一方向与 Gold 一致；但组内变化幅度明显低估，而且模型的 Day 3-31/BSID points 与 Gold 的 Day 1 and 31/SSI scale score 不是完全同一口径。

次要有效性是主要缺口。模型把 secondary-1 写成“Opioid activity assessment (receptor occupancy or biomarker) Day 3-31”，并明确 effect_point 为 null、confidence 为 0.3。可是 Gold 的 secondary-1 实际是 MADRS Change Score：OG000 baseline 34.6、change -15.8；OG001 baseline 33.5、change -8.5，单位同为 score on a scale。Gold 还包含 secondary-2 HAM-D Change Score：OG000 baseline 23.9、change -9.9；OG001 baseline 23.0、change -5.57。模型没有给 secondary-2 任何预测。因此，这个样本不是单纯数值偏差，而是正式可评估端点展开后，模型遗漏了两个抑郁量表端点中的一个，并把另一个解释成 opioid activity。

安全性分析方面，模型列出 respiratory depression、abuse potential、withdrawal，并称没有预期新的安全信号。这个安全框架与 buprenorphine 的常识性风险方向相容，也有助于解释为什么模型没有把安全性当作主要失败驱动因素。不过本 packet 的 Gold 不提供安全 endpoint 数值；search_context 也主要保留了搜索结果列表和 URL，关键 fetch 对 EuropePMC 37019069 与 10.31525/ct1-nct04116528 没有正文返回。因此安全性只能评价为可见分析覆盖了风险类别，不能评价为已由本样本证据证明安全结论正确。
